segments.name: Pharmaceuticals
segments.description: A global R&D-driven biopharmaceutical company delivering treatments in gastrointestinal and inflammation, neuroscience, oncology, plasma-derived therapies and vaccines.
segments.evidence: Takeda is a global R&D-driven biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering and delivering life-transforming treatments in our core therapeutic areas of gastrointestinal and inflammation, neuroscience and oncology, as well as through our plasma-derived therapies and vaccines business.

revenueModel.text: Takeda earns revenue from sales of its pharmaceutical products to healthcare payers and purchasers, including government-controlled health authorities, publicly funded health programs, insurance companies and managed care organizations.
revenueModel.evidence: healthcare payers around the globe, in particular government-controlled health authorities, publicly funded or subsidized health programs, insurance companies and managed care organizations, increasingly pursue initiatives to reduce the overall cost of healthcare
